comment: Conformance vectors for GLink v1 (every implementation must run all lists, reader_cases included) (docs/GLINK-PROTOCOL.md). Read by tools/tests/test_glink_contract.py; later steps run the same data against the C++ codec and the Python mirror. Strings in request/response/message fields are the exact UTF-8 bytes of the message.
